〔几乎气声·一句〕"这花……开得真好。"

不字正腔圆、略带真实的呼吸停顿；全程仅两处极短轻语。

手持质感（极轻微自然晃动与呼吸感），多分镜：

真实浅景深、焦点偶有极细微的呼吸式重对焦，背景宫阙牡丹虚化。

空气微尘、花瓣偶尔飘落、纱披与碎发随真实微风动，

title: Reach the Moon
prompt: A cinematic 15-second surreal epic in one continuous escalating shot. Start in a quiet city street at golden hour, grounded realism, rich natural light, subtle wind, detailed reflections in windows. A man in ordinary clothes stands center frame, studies a tiny glowing pill, swallows it, and smiles nervously. At first nothing happens — then he grows. Not in jumps, but continuously, absurdly, every second larger than the last. The camera pulls back and cranes up frantically to keep him in frame as cars become toys, buildings shrink to knee height, people scatter like dust. His expression shifts from surprise to childlike awe. Clouds part around his chest, airplanes streak past him, the skyline drops below his waist, then the curvature of Earth appears. Lighting evolves from warm sunset to cold stratospheric blue to stark moonlit silver. He keeps growing, calm and enormous, until his face reaches the moon. Final beat: he gently leans forward, taps the moon like a door, and it ripples like water.

title: Hummingbird Macro Nature Moment
prompt:
RealisticHummingbird macro, one continuous takeSetup: The camera begins in an extreme macro close-up on the eye of the subject, a hummingbird, hovering in front of a magenta hibiscus stamen. The lighting is high-contrast HDR sunlight.
[Stage 1] Initial state: The subject's eye is wide, reflecting the tropical sun. Primary event: The subject blinks its nictitating membrane slowly, while the camera orbits the eye to reveal the iridescent crown feathers. End state: The camera is positioned at a 45-degree angle looking down at the bird's forehead.
[Stage 2] Continue from the previous stage: Position at the forehead. Primary event: The camera slides down the length of the slender black beak, following a single glistening nectar droplet toward the tip. End state: Beak tip is centered, droplet hanging precariously.
[Stage 3] Continue from the previous stage: Droplet at the tip of the beak. Primary event: The subject's tongue flicks out twice at 1000fps slow motion, disturbing the droplet into a fine mist. End state: Beak is dry, tongue retracted, camera begins to pull back.
[Stage 4] Continue from the previous stage: Camera pulling back from the head. Primary event: The camera orbits to the right side of the subject, focusing on the shoulder joint where feathers flex against the skin. End state: Shoulder joint and upper wing are in sharp focus.
[Stage 5] Continue from the previous stage: Focus on the wing joint. Primary event: The wing completes a downward stroke, and the camera follows the pressure wave as it ripples the downy emerald feathers on the subject's chest. End state: Feathers settled, chest muscle visible beneath the plumage.
[Stage 6] Continue from the previous stage: Focus on the chest. Primary event: The camera dives between the subject and the hibiscus stamen, capturing the golden pollen grains suspended in the air. End state: Stamen is in the foreground, subject in the mid-ground.
[Stage 7] Continue from the previous stage: Stamen in foreground. Primary event: The subject shifts forward 1cm, its wingtip brushing the stamen and dislodging a thick cloud of golden pollen. End state: Pollen cloud surrounds the bird's head.
[Stage 8] Continue from the previous stage: Pollen cloud in air. Primary event: The camera tracks a single grain of pollen as it rolls across the oily surface of a flight feather, revealing microscopic barbs. End state: Pollen grain falls out of frame.
[Stage 9] Continue from the previous stage: Macro wing surface. Primary event: The camera pulls back rapidly while remaining in slow motion, revealing the full figure-eight path of the wings. End state: Half-body profile of the subject suspended in mid-air.
[Stage 10] Continue from the previous stage: Half-body profile. Primary event: The subject rotates its body 90 degrees to face the flower directly, its ruby gorget feathers catching the light and flashing from black to brilliant red. End state: Subject is head-on with the stamen.
[Stage 11] Continue from the previous stage: Head-on orientation. Primary event: The camera tilts up to include the sun's glare, creating a prismatic lens flare that washes over the magenta petals. End state: Sun flare at the top of the frame, subject centered.
[Stage 12] Continue from the previous stage: Sun-flared composition. Primary event: The subject stabilizes in a perfect hover, wings creating a rhythmic blurring halo, as the camera completes a slow circular orbit to a wide profile. End state: Final composition of the subject beside the hibiscus in pristine 4K detail.
[Maintain Consistency] Keep the subject's emerald and ruby feather pattern, the magenta hibiscus color, and the single-shot continuous camera movement consistent. No cuts or resets.

Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic.

title: Lake Placid The King's Bait
prompt:
A high-budget medieval fantasy spectacle set beside a vast dark lake under heavy overcast skies. Cold winds sweep across a cliffside packed with Viking-style warriors, armored soldiers, and a roaring crowd gathered around a massive wooden catapult. War drums echo, banners whip violently, ropes creak under tension.
0–2s — Hook:
Low, atmospheric shot over the lake. Beneath the surface, a gigantic crocodile-like creature glides silently, its massive silhouette visible through dark water. One eye slowly rises above the surface. Ripples expand outward. A deep rumble builds.
2–6s — Setup (Loading):
Wide cinematic shot of a colossal wooden catapult mounted on a stone platform. Warriors struggle to load a full-grown cow into the sling, securing it with thick ropes and stretched hide. The structure groans under tension. Dust and hay swirl in the wind. Above, a heavily armored king watches silently, unmoving.
6–9s — Command (Tension Peak):
Close on the catapult mechanism. Ropes are pulled tighter. Wood creaks loudly. One warrior looks to the king. The king gives a subtle nod. A loud command breaks the tension: "GO!" The ropes strain to their absolute limit as the system locks and holds for a split second.
9–14s — Payoff (Bullet Time Action):
Release. The catapult snaps forward and launches the cow into the air. Bullet time engages. The camera rotates around the cow mid-flight as it spins above the lake. Below, the water churns violently. The massive crocodile erupts upward in slow motion, jaws wide. Water explodes around it. It intercepts the cow mid-air in a suspended moment—droplets, debris, and motion frozen—before gravity resumes and both crash violently back into the lake.
14–15s — Final Beat:
Cut to the king. He rises, fist in the air, shouting "YEAH!" as the crowd erupts behind him.

title: Rooftop Chase Escape
prompt:
EXT. RAIN-SOAKED CITY ROOFTOP — NIGHT
Heavy rain pounds the city. Neon lights bleed across wet concrete thirty stories below. Thunder cracks.
MARCUS (35, black tactical jacket, bleeding from his left arm) sprints across the rooftop — each footstep splashing puddles.
MARCUS
(into earpiece, breathless)
I've got the drive. But they cut off the south exit.
VOICE (V.O.)
(through static)
There is no other way out, Marcus. Jump.
Marcus skids to a stop at the rooftop edge. He looks down. A long drop. An adjacent building — fifteen feet away.
Behind him — THREE ARMED MEN burst through the rooftop door. Red laser sights sweep through the rain.
AGENT VOSS
(cold, stepping forward)
Hand over the drive, Marcus.
There's nowhere left to go.
A long beat. Marcus doesn't turn around. He looks at the gap. Then down. Then closes his eyes.
MARCUS
(quietly, to himself)
You should've killed me when you had the chance.
He RUNS.
Gunshots CRACK. Sparks fly off the roof ledge.
Marcus LAUNCHES off the edge — body stretched — suspended in the rain for one breathless second —
— He CRASHES onto the adjacent rooftop. Rolls. Slams into an HVAC unit. Groans.
He looks at his hand. The drive — still there.
Behind him, across the gap, Voss watches in silence. Then slowly raises his radio.
VOSS
(into radio)
He's heading east. Lock down the district.
And call the helicopter.
Marcus pulls himself up. Limping. Bleeding. But moving.
He looks at the horizon — a sea of city lights and rain.
MARCUS
(whispering)
Not tonight.
He disappears into the darkness.
CUT TO BLACK.

title: Madrid Metro Telekinesis Scene
prompt:
Crea un vídeo cinematográfico de 15 segundos en una estación de metro abarrotada en Madrid. Hay un cartel que pone que la parada de metro se llama "GptZone"
Un hombre en un bonito traje negro con mangas enrolladas y una corbata aflojada camina normalmente a través de una plataforma de metro concurrida rodeado de multitudes que viajan. De repente, los enemigos (robots futuristas) aparecen de ambos lados atacando, creando un enfrentamiento tenso en la plataforma. Mientras los enemigos se apresuran hacia él, el hombre desata un poderoso ataque telequinético. De repente, todo a su alrededor entra en un estado de ingravidez y el tiempo se congela al chasquear los dedos.
Docenas de artículos, periódicos abiertos, tazas de café, equipaje, mochilas y una lata de refresco roja, salen del suelo, perfectamente suspendiéndose en mitad del aire. Los atacantes, están congelados en el aire por una fuerza invisible. Páginas de papel, recibos, y polvo flotan y gira alrededor de él sin peso.
La cámara se acerca lentamente al hombre, congelando perfectamente la plataforma caótica en el estado de quietud y suspensión inducido por telequinética. En la extrema quietud de la imagen congelada lentamente, los ojos calmados del hombre se estrechan ligeramente. Inmediatamente después, calmadamente levantó su mano derecha, los dedos apretados sueltamente, y luego hizo un ligero pero decisivo movimiento de la manga a cada lado de su cuerpo. En un instante, el tiempo congelado y la gravedad parecieron explotar con este sutil gesto. Un bajo estruendo se hizo eco en el aire, y docenas de objetos que habían sido suspendidos en el aire—una pieza pesada de equipaje, periódicos dispersos, incluso la lata de refresco roja— se transformaron en una densa proyección, llevando poderosas corrientes de aire, y fueron lanzados precisamente hacia los enemigos que atacan desde ambos lados. Al mismo tiempo, una onda de choque psíquica circular invisible se extendió violentamente del hombre. Los atacantes, que habían sido congelados en el aire, fueron instantáneamente golpeados por esta fuerza inmensa, sus cuerpos sacudieron violentamente, y fueron enviados volando hacia atrás como cometas con cuerdas rotas a ambos extremos de la plataforma. A medida que la gravedad regresaba instantáneamente, el equipaje se rompió con el impacto, los periódicos se dispersaron en una ráfaga de páginas, y con el torso de objetos pesados golpeando el suelo, los atacantes se derrumbaron sobre el suelo del andén del metro, incapacitados.
El silencio volvió a la plataforma, roto sólo por incontables papeles destrozados y el fino polvo a la deriva lentamente en el aire. Las réplicas de la onda de choque al hombre alborotaron el pelo y la chaqueta del traje. Permaneció compuesto, ni siquiera mirando a su oponente caído. El hombre bajó lentamente su mano derecha, levantó su delgada izquierda, y ajustó con gracia y tranquilidad su corbata aflojada, revelando su perfil tranquilo y determinado. La cámara se congela brevemente en este momento, papeles blancos cayendo a su alrededor como copos de nieve, resaltando su figura todavía en un traje gris con mangas enrolladas. Entonces, el hombre continúa caminando normalmente hacia atraás entre la multitud de viajeros, como si nada hubiera pasado, desapareciendo en la distancia de la plataforma.

title: Erik vs The Ski Jump Cinematic
prompt:
"Use the attached ERIK VS THE SKI JUMP character sheet throughout. Erik: Pixar 3D man, mid 20s, lean athletic build, bright red and yellow ski suit, white helmet, goggles, skis. Pixar 3D render throughout. No realistic humans.
THE SETTING: Bright winter Olympic ski jump venue. Vivid white snow, brilliant blue sky, dramatic mountains behind. Packed crowd. No dark frames.
MUSIC: Tense silence at start. Powerful orchestral explodes the moment Erik launches. Near silence during slow motion peak. Full crowd roar from landing to end.
0:00–0:02 — Wide shot. Erik at the top of the ramp, crouched, goggles down, poles planted. Crowd silent. Mountains behind him. SOUND: Crowd murmur. Wind.
0:02–0:03 — Close on Erik's face. Locked in. Eyes forward. One breath. SOUND: Near silence.
0:03–0:05 — Erik releases. Full speed down the ramp, body low and aerodynamic, snow rushing past. SOUND: Music builds. Crowd rising.
0:05–0:06 — Erik launches off the end of the ramp — skis leaving the surface, body fully committed, arms back. SOUND: Crowd gasps. Music explodes.
0:06–0:09 — SLOW MOTION. Erik fully airborne — body perfectly horizontal, leaning forward, skis spread in a wide V. Vast snowy valley far below. Blue sky above. Complete silence. SOUND: Dead silence. One low cello note.
0:09–0:11 — Slow motion ends. Erik descends fast toward the slope. SOUND: Music returns driving hard. Crowd roaring.
0:11–0:13 — Perfect landing — skis hit the slope, snow spraying wide, one arm out for balance. Distance marker visible — massive number. Crowd erupts. SOUND: Skis on snow. Full crowd explosion.
0:13–0:15 — Erik at the bottom, poles raised, head back, crowd roaring, mountains and blue sky behind. Wide stadium shot. Flags waving. Fade out. SOUND: Full crowd roar fading. Silence.
Camera: wide ramp top, close face, tracking descent, launch, slow motion wide airborne, fast descent, landing snow spray, wide celebration. Bright Pixar colors throughout."

title: NYC Golden Hour Flying Action
prompt:
Create a highly cinematic, photorealistic action sequence featuring a young man wearing a brown jacket, white shirt, blue jeans, and sneakers running through a crowded New York City street during golden hour. The video begins with a dramatic close-up of his hand and body as he runs between moving yellow taxis and city traffic. Suddenly, he pushes off the ground and becomes weightless, rising naturally into the air. He flies forward above the busy street, moving between tall skyscrapers while yellow taxis and pedestrians remain far below.
The camera follows his movement dynamically from different natural angles, including a low-angle tracking shot, side-following shot, and a wide aerial perspective. As he flies close to the side of a skyscraper, his body rotates naturally in mid-air before he continues moving forward through the city skyline. He then gradually descends back toward street level, lands smoothly, and immediately continues running through the traffic without stopping.
The scene transitions naturally as he reaches a rooftop overlooking New York City at sunset. He runs toward the edge of the rooftop and suddenly begins floating upward again, slowly levitating several feet above the roof with his arms slightly extended. The camera pulls backward and upward, revealing the massive glowing city skyline behind him as the sun sets between the skyscrapers.
Ultra-realistic human movement and anatomy, realistic gravity and weightlessness, natural body physics, detailed facial expressions, realistic clothing movement, wind interaction, authentic New York City environment, moving traffic, atmospheric depth, warm golden-hour sunlight, cinematic shadows, subtle lens flare, realistic reflections on vehicles and windows, shallow depth of field, natural motion blur, smooth camera tracking, dramatic scale, premium Hollywood action-film cinematography, anamorphic lens look, highly detailed textures, photorealistic 4K quality.
Maintain consistent character appearance, clothing, face, hairstyle, and proportions throughout the entire video. Make every transition smooth and physically believable. No cuts, no text, no subtitles, no logos, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no warped body, no duplicate people, no unnatural facial changes.
